item.title: IBM to Acquire Confluent
item.description:
📝 Confluent Team, I’m excited to share that a few moments ago, we announced that Confluent has signed an agreement to be acquired by IBM in an all cash deal for $31. item.title: Microsoft is quietly walking back its diversity efforts
item.description:
📝 Game File reported last week that Microsoft will cease publication of its diversity and inclusion reports this year. Microsoft employees always had to answer “What impact did your actions have in contributing to a more diverse and inclusive Microsoft. Microsoft is still publishing its Inside Inclusion newsletter and “Code of Us” stories that highlight experiences from Microsoft employees with diverse backgrounds,.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theverge.com/tech/838079/microsoft-diversity-and-inclusion-changes-notepad
